label: PF Backlog 399
title: PFSSOT-P7: worker adapter interface (OpenCode first, scheduler decoupled)
body: Doc docs/PF-Backlog-SSOT-Scheduler-Pluggable-Workers-updated.md §17/§18/§39 Phase 7. Runtime-neutral adapter contract (register/heartbeat/status/accept/start/pause/cancel/report_result/disconnect); OpenCode first adapter; scheduler talks to abstraction not OpenCode. Gate: scheduler can assign work through the adapter abstraction.
